groups.canonical_sql: WITH balances AS (SELECT dl.product_id,m.location_id,SUM(m.qty_delta_milli) AS on_hand_milli FROM INVENTORY_MOVEMENTS m JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES dl ON dl.document_line_id=m.document_line_id JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d ON d.document_id=dl.document_id WHERE d.document_status='POSTED' AND d.posted_at_utc < '2025-04-01T00:00:00.000Z' GROUP BY dl.product_id,m.location_id) SELECT p.product_id,p.sku,l.location_id,l.location_code,b.on_hand_milli FROM balances b JOIN PRODUCTS p ON p.product_id=b.product_id JOIN LOCATIONS l ON l.location_id=b.location_id WHERE l.location_type='QUARANTINE' AND b.on_hand_milli>0 ORDER BY p.product_id,l.location_id

card_fields.brief: Tính tổng biến động posted trước một UTC instant, tại một product-location?
card_fields.entity_grain: product/location; signed qty milli-unit
card_fields.filters_group_time: `posted_at_utc < cutoff`; ordered by `posted_seq` for same timestamp/batch; posted only
card_fields.null_tie: Same timestamp alone cannot imply order; sum includes all legs in eligible batch
card_fields.business_rules: UTC millisecond + posting sequence/batch identity
card_fields.fixture_evidence: 4 docs share timestamp; `posted_seq` differentiates; test instant at cutoff and paired transfer atomicity

groups.canonical_sql: SELECT dl.product_id,m.location_id,SUM(m.qty_delta_milli) AS on_hand_change_milli FROM INVENTORY_MOVEMENTS m JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES dl ON dl.document_line_id=m.document_line_id JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d ON d.document_id=dl.document_id WHERE d.document_status='POSTED' AND d.posted_at_utc<'2025-04-01T00:00:00.000Z' GROUP BY dl.product_id,m.location_id ORDER BY dl.product_id,m.location_id
groups.canonical_sql_draft: SELECT dl.product_id,m.location_id,SUM(m.qty_delta_milli) AS on_hand_change_milli FROM INVENTORY_MOVEMENTS m JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES dl ON dl.document_line_id=m.document_line_id JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d ON d.document_id=dl.document_id WHERE d.document_status='POSTED' AND d.posted_at_utc<'2025-04-01T00:00:00.000Z' GROUP BY dl.product_id,m.location_id ORDER BY dl.product_id,m.location_id

card_fields.classification: NULL / Simple: absence at location scope
card_fields.brief: Tìm SKU chưa có biến động tại các vị trí PICKING?
card_fields.entity_grain: product/location; one pair/SKU-location; SKU, location, category
card_fields.filters_group_time: Product cross active PICKING locations anti-joined to posted movements
card_fields.null_tie: No movement at this location is absence, not zero balance; category NULL retained; expected nonempty
card_fields.business_rules: Product may move elsewhere while lacking movement at a specific location
card_fields.fixture_evidence: No picking locations have movement in snapshot; test that anti-join is scoped by location, and add a fixture with one picking movement to detect false positives

groups.canonical_sql: SELECT p.product_id,p.sku,l.location_id,l.location_code FROM PRODUCTS p CROSS JOIN LOCATIONS l WHERE l.location_type='PICKING' AND l.is_active=1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM INVENTORY_MOVEMENTS m JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES dl ON dl.document_line_id=m.document_line_id JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d ON d.document_id=dl.document_id WHERE dl.product_id=p.product_id AND m.location_id=l.location_id AND d.document_status='POSTED') ORDER BY p.product_id,l.location_id

card_fields.classification: NULL / Moderate: distinguish no history from net zero
card_fields.brief: Liệt kê product-location có movement history nhưng net balance bằng 0, riêng với location không có movement?
card_fields.entity_grain: product/location; balance/state label
card_fields.filters_group_time: Aggregate posted movements by product-location; compare net=0; separately anti-join no history
card_fields.null_tie: Zero-with-history vs absence explicit; NULL not zero
card_fields.business_rules: Balance only from posted legs; nonnegative after posting batch
card_fields.fixture_evidence: Current snapshot has no zero-with-history and no picking/QTN movement; needs two fixtures; related to NA01/AG03

groups.canonical_sql: WITH movement_balance AS (SELECT dl.product_id,m.location_id,COUNT(*) AS movement_count,SUM(m.qty_delta_milli) AS q FROM INVENTORY_MOVEMENTS m JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES dl ON dl.document_line_id=m.document_line_id JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d ON d.document_id=dl.document_id WHERE d.document_status='POSTED' GROUP BY dl.product_id,m.location_id) SELECT p.product_id,p.sku,l.location_id,l.location_code,CASE WHEN b.product_id IS NULL THEN 'NO_HISTORY' WHEN b.q=0 THEN 'ZERO_WITH_HISTORY' ELSE 'NONZERO' END AS balance_state,COALESCE(b.q,0) AS on_hand_milli FROM PRODUCTS p CROSS JOIN LOCATIONS l LEFT JOIN movement_balance b ON b.product_id=p.product_id AND b.location_id=l.location_id WHERE b.product_id IS NULL OR b.q=0 ORDER BY p.product_id,l.location_id
groups.canonical_sql_draft: WITH movement_balance AS (SELECT dl.product_id,m.location_id,COUNT(*) AS movement_count,SUM(m.qty_delta_milli) AS q FROM INVENTORY_MOVEMENTS m JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES dl ON dl.document_line_id=m.document_line_id JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d ON d.document_id=dl.document_id WHERE d.document_status='POSTED' GROUP BY dl.product_id,m.location_id) SELECT p.product_id,p.sku,l.location_id,l.location_code,CASE WHEN b.product_id IS NULL THEN 'NO_HISTORY' WHEN b.q=0 THEN 'ZERO_WITH_HISTORY' ELSE 'NONZERO' END AS balance_state,COALESCE(b.q,0) AS on_hand_milli FROM PRODUCTS p CROSS JOIN LOCATIONS l LEFT JOIN movement_balance b ON b.product_id=p.product_id AND b.location_id=l.location_id WHERE b.product_id IS NULL OR b.q=0 ORDER BY p.product_id,l.location_id

card_fields.classification: Conditional / Moderate: posted shipment vs other posted movement
card_fields.brief: Tính tổng lượng xuất CUSTOMER_SHIPMENT và tổng signed movement của sản phẩm theo unit?
card_fields.entity_grain: product/unit; two measures
card_fields.filters_group_time: Posted only; conditional SUM by document type; fixed window
card_fields.null_tie: No rows→undefined/0 per explicit output contract; zero net with movements retained
card_fields.business_rules: Posted movement sign; exclude draft/cancelled
card_fields.fixture_evidence: 20 posted shipments; fixture same SKU receipt/adjustment and non-posted shipment

groups.canonical_sql: SELECT p.product_id,p.sku,p.base_unit,SUM(CASE WHEN d.document_type='SHIPMENT' AND m.qty_delta_milli<0 THEN -m.qty_delta_milli ELSE 0 END) AS shipped_qty_milli,SUM(m.qty_delta_milli) AS all_net_movement_milli FROM INVENTORY_MOVEMENTS m JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES dl ON dl.document_line_id=m.document_line_id JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d ON d.document_id=dl.document_id JOIN PRODUCTS p ON p.product_id=dl.product_id WHERE d.document_status='POSTED' GROUP BY p.product_id,p.sku,p.base_unit ORDER BY p.product_id
groups.canonical_sql_draft: SELECT p.product_id,p.sku,p.base_unit,SUM(CASE WHEN d.document_type='SHIPMENT' AND m.qty_delta_milli<0 THEN -m.qty_delta_milli ELSE 0 END) AS shipped_qty_milli,SUM(m.qty_delta_milli) AS all_net_movement_milli FROM INVENTORY_MOVEMENTS m JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES dl ON dl.document_line_id=m.document_line_id JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d ON d.document_id=dl.document_id JOIN PRODUCTS p ON p.product_id=dl.product_id WHERE d.document_status='POSTED' GROUP BY p.product_id,p.sku,p.base_unit ORDER BY p.product_id

card_fields.classification: Conditional / Moderate: planned vs executed by status/type and document-SKU grain
card_fields.brief: Với mọi cặp document × SKU, bất kể trạng thái, trả document ID/no/type/status, SKU, base unit, planned quantity và executed quantity theo milli-unit; executed bằng 0 nếu document chưa POSTED, TRANSFER chỉ tính SOURCE leg một lần, loại POSTED khác theo movement rules đã chốt.
card_fields.entity_grain: document × product; 1 row/document-SKU; document no/type/status, SKU/base_unit, planned milli-unit, executed milli-unit
card_fields.filters_group_time: Giữ tất cả status; planned=sum document lines; executed chỉ từ POSTED movement; TRANSFER dùng SOURCE leg một lần; các loại khác dùng tổng ABS movement theo rules đã chốt
card_fields.null_tie: DRAFT/CANCELLED executed=0; POSTED thiếu movement là 0 theo synthetic invariant; không nhân planned khi join movement; không cộng khác base_unit
card_fields.business_rules: WMS BR-02/BR-06: signed movement; transfer có SOURCE âm và DESTINATION dương cùng lượng; document non-posted không hiệu lực; synthetic measure theo Owner decision 2026-11-09
card_fields.fixture_evidence: Temporary fixtures: transfer có hai legs nhưng executed=planned một lần; posted receipt/shipment/adjustment/return khớp invariant; draft receipt và cancelled shipment planned>0, executed=0

groups.canonical_sql: WITH planned AS (SELECT document_id,product_id,SUM(planned_qty_milli) AS planned_qty_milli FROM INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES GROUP BY document_id,product_id), executed AS (SELECT dl.document_id,dl.product_id,SUM(CASE WHEN d.document_type='TRANSFER' THEN CASE WHEN m.movement_role='SOURCE' THEN ABS(m.qty_delta_milli) ELSE 0 END ELSE ABS(m.qty_delta_milli) END) AS executed_qty_milli FROM INVENTORY_MOVEMENTS m JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES dl ON dl.document_line_id=m.document_line_id JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d ON d.document_id=dl.document_id WHERE d.document_status='POSTED' GROUP BY dl.document_id,dl.product_id) SELECT d.document_id,d.document_no,d.document_type,d.document_status,p.sku,p.base_unit,pl.planned_qty_milli,COALESCE(ex.executed_qty_milli,0) AS executed_qty_milli FROM INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d JOIN planned pl ON pl.document_id=d.document_id JOIN PRODUCTS p ON p.product_id=pl.product_id LEFT JOIN executed ex ON ex.document_id=pl.document_id AND ex.product_id=pl.product_id ORDER BY d.document_id,p.product_id
groups.canonical_sql_draft: WITH planned AS (SELECT document_id,product_id,SUM(planned_qty_milli) AS planned_qty_milli FROM INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES GROUP BY document_id,product_id), executed AS (SELECT dl.document_id,dl.product_id,SUM(CASE WHEN d.document_type='TRANSFER' THEN CASE WHEN m.movement_role='SOURCE' THEN ABS(m.qty_delta_milli) ELSE 0 END ELSE ABS(m.qty_delta_milli) END) AS executed_qty_milli FROM INVENTORY_MOVEMENTS m JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES dl ON dl.document_line_id=m.document_line_id JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d ON d.document_id=dl.document_id WHERE d.document_status='POSTED' GROUP BY dl.document_id,dl.product_id) SELECT d.document_id,d.document_no,d.document_type,d.document_status,p.sku,p.base_unit,pl.planned_qty_milli,COALESCE(ex.executed_qty_milli,0) AS executed_qty_milli FROM INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d JOIN planned pl ON pl.document_id=d.document_id JOIN PRODUCTS p ON p.product_id=pl.product_id LEFT JOIN executed ex ON ex.document_id=pl.document_id AND ex.product_id=pl.product_id ORDER BY d.document_id,p.product_id

questions.question: Liệt kê product-location có movement history nhưng net balance bằng 0, riêng với location không có movement?
questions.canonical_sql: WITH movement_balance AS (SELECT dl.product_id,m.location_id,COUNT(*) AS movement_count,SUM(m.qty_delta_milli) AS q FROM INVENTORY_MOVEMENTS m JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES dl ON dl.document_line_id=m.document_line_id JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d ON d.document_id=dl.document_id WHERE d.document_status='POSTED' GROUP BY dl.product_id,m.location_id) SELECT p.product_id,p.sku,l.location_id,l.location_code,CASE WHEN b.product_id IS NULL THEN 'NO_HISTORY' WHEN b.q=0 THEN 'ZERO_WITH_HISTORY' ELSE 'NONZERO' END AS balance_state,COALESCE(b.q,0) AS on_hand_milli FROM PRODUCTS p CROSS JOIN LOCATIONS l LEFT JOIN movement_balance b ON b.product_id=p.product_id AND b.location_id=l.location_id WHERE b.product_id IS NULL OR b.q=0 ORDER BY p.product_id,l.location_id
questions.semantic_review_basis: Structured slots inherited; wording not human-verified.

questions.question: Với mọi cặp document × SKU, bất kể trạng thái, trả document ID/no/type/status, SKU, base unit, planned quantity và executed quantity theo milli-unit; executed bằng 0 nếu document chưa POSTED, TRANSFER chỉ tính SOURCE leg một lần, loại POSTED khác theo movement rules đã chốt.
questions.canonical_sql: WITH planned AS (SELECT document_id,product_id,SUM(planned_qty_milli) AS planned_qty_milli FROM INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES GROUP BY document_id,product_id), executed AS (SELECT dl.document_id,dl.product_id,SUM(CASE WHEN d.document_type='TRANSFER' THEN CASE WHEN m.movement_role='SOURCE' THEN ABS(m.qty_delta_milli) ELSE 0 END ELSE ABS(m.qty_delta_milli) END) AS executed_qty_milli FROM INVENTORY_MOVEMENTS m JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES dl ON dl.document_line_id=m.document_line_id JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d ON d.document_id=dl.document_id WHERE d.document_status='POSTED' GROUP BY dl.document_id,dl.product_id) SELECT d.document_id,d.document_no,d.document_type,d.document_status,p.sku,p.base_unit,pl.planned_qty_milli,COALESCE(ex.executed_qty_milli,0) AS executed_qty_milli FROM INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d JOIN planned pl ON pl.document_id=d.document_id JOIN PRODUCTS p ON p.product_id=pl.product_id LEFT JOIN executed ex ON ex.document_id=pl.document_id AND ex.product_id=pl.product_id ORDER BY d.document_id,p.product_id

questions.question: Cho từng chứng từ với từng SKU trong đó, bất kể trạng thái, liệt kê mã chứng từ, số chứng từ, loại chứng từ, trạng thái, SKU, đơn vị cơ sở, lượng theo kế hoạch và lượng thực tế đã thực hiện bằng milli-unit. questions.canonical_sql: WITH planned AS (SELECT document_id,product_id,SUM(planned_qty_milli) AS planned_qty_milli FROM INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES GROUP BY document_id,product_id), executed AS (SELECT dl.document_id,dl.product_id,SUM(CASE WHEN d.document_type='TRANSFER' THEN CASE WHEN m.movement_role='SOURCE' THEN ABS(m.qty_delta_milli) ELSE 0 END ELSE ABS(m.qty_delta_milli) END) AS executed_qty_milli FROM INVENTORY_MOVEMENTS m JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENT_LINES dl ON dl.document_line_id=m.document_line_id JOIN INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d ON d.document_id=dl.document_id WHERE d.document_status='POSTED' GROUP BY dl.document_id,dl.product_id) SELECT d.document_id,d.document_no,d.document_type,d.document_status,p.sku,p.base_unit,pl.planned_qty_milli,COALESCE(ex.executed_qty_milli,0) AS executed_qty_milli FROM INVENTORY_DOCUMENTS d JOIN planned pl ON pl.document_id=d.document_id JOIN PRODUCTS p ON p.product_id=pl.product_id LEFT JOIN executed ex ON ex.document_id=pl.document_id AND ex.product_id=pl.product_id ORDER BY d.document_id,p.product_id
